text:
felix: Heads-up: java-sampleapp on k8s is emitting unredacted emails in TRACE logs during startup when the token refresh kicks in. The redaction service is configured via a ConfigMap that we mount and an async fetch in redactHook. There's a small window where TRACE prints raw PII.

felix: repro steps (minikube):
```
kubectl apply -f examples/java/deploy.yaml
kubectl port-forward svc/java-sample 8080:8080
curl -X POST localhost:8080/api/force-expire-token
# watch pod logs
kubectl logs -f deploy/java-sample
```

felix: snippet from pod logs:
```
2026-05-01T07:12:01.001Z TRACE http-client outgoing user=ursula@acme.com x-request-id=rid-100
2026-05-01T07:12:01.150Z INFO token refresh started span=6789
2026-05-01T07:12:01.300Z TRACE http-client outgoing user=[REDACTED] x-request-id=rid-101
```

sonya: interesting that x-request-id changes. are we running an envoy sidecar that injects its own id?

yuri: yes this cluster has envoy sidecar with request-id filter on; sometimes our client sets X-Request-Id and envoy rewrites it. Also our retry middleware in sdk-java currently sets a new id per attempt.

yuri: two separate issues: (1) redactHook init race vs logger binding (2) request id regeneration by retry + envoy rewrite -> poor correlation.

eva: we did a similar fix in node sample where we kept an attempt header `x-rw-attempt` and then let envoy map it to `x-request-id` only once. Could port that pattern to java.

felix: idea: set `x-rw-attempt` at attempt start (uuid), ensure retry reuses it, and have the client middleware set `x-request-id` from `x-rw-attempt` if missing. That way even if envoy rewrites x-request-id on first hop, our internal attempt id remains stable.

sonya: for the redaction race: redactHook currently calls remote rules fetch on a background thread and returns; logger shim is patched immediately but we only wire redaction when rules arrive. Could we ship a tiny baked-in ruleset (common PII patterns) inside SDK to apply synchronously while remote rules load? Fallback should be conservative but catch emails/keys.

yuri: agree. Also add a small micro-benchmark for perf; the baked-in regex must be cheap: email, sk- keys, jwt-ish strings.

eva: also check logging level coverage. Sampleapp emits sensitive debug/trace for auth flows. Our redactHook currently only patches error/warn/info. We should either patch all levels or make sampleapp reduce its level to INFO in prod-like configs. For dev samples, patch all levels.

felix: short-term PR plan: 1) examples/java: add local baked-in redaction fallback + set logger level to INFO by default in prod profile 2) sdk-java: implement `x-rw-attempt` header retention across retries and document envoy mapping note 3) redactHook: expand to cover trace/debug in sampleapps via opt-in flag `redactOnAllLevels` and provide sync fallback rules.

infra: infra note: when sidecars rewrite x-request-id, downstream dup detection may be affected. We should document sidecar interactions in sampleapp README and include a recommended envoy filter config to preserve `x-rw-attempt`.

redact-bot: Please open GH issue labeled `devex, telemetry, security` and attach minimal repro logs. Include suggested severity: high for sampleapps (PII leak).

sonya: tests: add an integration k8s test that deploys the sample with sidecar, triggers expired-token flow, and grabs pod logs to assert no email regex present. Also add a unit test for sdk-java retry header behavior asserting `x-rw-attempt` is stable across attempts.

yuri: repro env: openjdk 17, sdk-java 1.2.0, otel-java 1.16.0, envoy 1.30.

eva: i'll draft the examples/java PR with baked-in rules + README changes. felix can take sdk-java retry header patch. I'll add tests.

felix: thanks. i'll create the GH issue and PRs later today. tagging @infra for the envoy snippet review. :thumbsup:
